summary: Add MinerPass V2 source/recipient planning and verification before funding
details: Prepare explicit source D and recipient E at a pinned confirmed state, including owner history, prev consumption and retained passes.
Verify the exact inscription, canonical confirmations, source, recipient and full configuration; incomplete evidence never approves funding.
Development-only regtest Ord execution selects a confirmed cardinal source coin and checks canonical inventory; production wallet signing and broadcasting remain unavailable.
The control-plane mint API now requires source_address and recipient_address. The indexer adds read-only source reconstruction and owner history capability fields.
operator_actions: Use these tools only on a network explicitly configured for MinerPass V2; this change does not activate or reset an existing network.
